Discounts are automatically applied to stays, no promo codes needed. The total price already includes your savings.

Welcome to..."Lovely Day 30A"



This luxurious coastal home boasts a beautifully decorated interior, a private fire pit, a covered patio, and 6 FREE bikes for use during your stay! As a guest at Lovely Day 30A you will enjoy having access to the many amenities found in and around this wonderfully located Inlet Beach neighborhood. You and your family are sure to love the neighborhood's large community pool, the dock for accessing Lake Powell, and all the while still being within walking distance to the many shops & restaurants of 30 Avenue! The home is just a short bike ride to reach the Rosemary Beach town center, and most importantly located only a 3-minute car ride/6 minute bike ride away from the beautiful white sandy beaches of the Emerald Coast!



This large beautiful vacation home features a family-friendly open floor plan with 2 Master Suites, a well-appointed gourmet kitchen with an expansive island, a 2nd living area, a guest room, a bunk room, a covered patio, and a private fire pit! The home was set up with your family's comfort in mind providing ample seating at both the large dining table and expansive kitchen island, as well as plenty of seating in the main family room area, and even more room to spread up on the 2nd floor in the homes second living room.



During your stay at "Lovely Day 30A," you will be able to enjoy all this beautiful home has to offer, as well as take advantage of accessing Lake Powell from the community private dock! Experience the fun of paddle boarding, kayaking, or fishing on one of 30A's world-famous Dune Lakes! Hot from a long day in the sun?? Inlet Beach & 30A's surrounding areas have you covered with their many wonderful restaurants, shops, and miles and miles of bike paths up and down Scenic 30A. At Lovely Day 30A you will immediately know that you have found your next annual family vacation destination!



Each reservation of this property includes a credit to be used towards beach gear rentals and services at La Dolce Vita. This includes bikes, paddle boards, kayaks, tours/experiences, and could even be used towards a beach bonfire for the entire family!



Sleeping Arrangements: Sleeps (12)



1st Floor:

Master Suite: King bed - private bathroom with walk-in shower, stackable washer and dryer in a large closet

Access to covered patio, grilling area, private fire pit

Gourmet Kitchen

Family Room



2nd Floor:

Master Suite: King bed - private bathroom with walk-in shower

Guest Room: Queen bed

Hallway bathroom with tub/shower combo

Bunk room - 2 sets of twin/twin bunk beds

Laundry room



Just one stay and you know its gonna be, its gonna be....a "Lovely Day 30A"



Amenities:

- Beach Access is only a 3-minute golf cart ride away.

- Community Pool

- Spacious open floor plan

- MAX 4 Designated parking spaces in total

- Gourmet Kitchen

- Community Dock with access to lake Powell.



Starter Amenity Package:



All guests are provided with an "amenity starter kit," which includes an initial supply of bath soap, shampoo, conditioner, shower gel, dishwasher pods ( x1) toilet paper, paper towels, hand soap, laundry pods (X1), and trash bags. These items are provided for your convenience, and are only intended to get you through your first 24-48 hours of your stay.



SUGGESTED ITEMS TO BRING Beach towels, beach chairs, sunscreen, sunglasses, bug spray, paper towels, toilet paper, trash bags, dishwasher detergent, laundry soap, bath soap, bicycles, rafts, coffee filters, antiseptic, flashlights, and beach toys.



FAQ's



*Distance to the beach? Short golf cart ride or bike ride away (3-minute golf cart ride/6 minute bike ride)

*Distance to Community Pool? The community pool is just around the corner from the home.

*Pool heated? No

*Grill on site? Yes

* The driveway will accommodate 4 vehicles MAX. Overflow parking is available at the community pool on a 1st come 1st serve basis.



**Please be aware that in this community and many others, there may be active construction going on. We are not held liable for this.**
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

We're delighted to know that you found the garage supplies like beach chairs and the cooler backpack useful and that the home was in fabulous condition. It's great to hear that the kitchen and comfortable beds added to your experience, and that you enjoyed the charming neighborhood and the pool facilities. We look forward to welcoming you back for another wonderful visit!

reviews.text: Highly recommend! Location is a super short car ride to Inlet beach public access where we had no trouble finding parking & a spot on the beach. Garage was stocked with beach chairs, wagon, umbrella and even a fabric backpack cooler. Inside was in fabulous condition, kitchen fully stocked and beds, pillows, linens VERY comfortable. Neighborhood is adorable and a walk or bike ride to the pool. We had a great stay and the host provided plenty of information that we’d need prior to arrival.
